purpose: Independently measure whether float midpoint subtraction changed observed exact decimal bid/ask midpoint direction, and quantify its effect on fixed saved 60-minute prediction scores without fitting or target mutation.

source_window.last_chunk_limit: The last compressed response physically includes early January 2026 development candles before TEST. Its pre-2026 rows alone are parsed into the calculation; no post-cutoff prices are selected or reported.
source_window.source_rule: Require complete source candle, strictly ordered exact minute clock, explicit string bid/ask opens, canonical float64 equality and exact source-row equality on every selected row. No price, missing-data, source or timestamp fallback.

comparison.decimal_definition: For each observed endpoint compare exact (terminal bid + terminal ask) to exact (entry bid + entry ask), on an integer decimal grid derived only from the bound selected source strings; division by two is unnecessary for sign.
comparison.safety: Fail closed on unsupported or overflowing exact integer representation; never infer an epsilon, round input price, impute a quote or fall back to float sign.
comparison.required_reports: All-parent globally observed matrix and separately the fold1 mature TRAIN and later populations; for every minute report saved versus exact down/zero/up confusion and genuine nonzero sign flips. Score all 60 fixed later predictions against both label versions with unchanged logits, output eligibility counts, AUC, accuracy, logloss and Brier; reproduce original scores from saved report before reporting differences.
comparison.inference: This is a retrospective label-integrity diagnosis on reused development. Point-score changes are not paired confidence intervals, untouched validation, feature attribution, actual fills or economic edge. Do not choose a best horizon.
comparison.data_retention: Write aggregate JSON and provenance only; do not write new target, quote, prediction, model weight or trading files. Preserve all original artifacts.
